title.zh: 【Miden 上线合作伙伴主网，计划数月内过渡至公开主网】
title.en: 【Miden 上线合作伙伴主网，计划数月内过渡至公开主网】

current_state.zh: Zero-knowledge chain Miden opened a partner-only mainnet with client-side proving, USDCx-denominated fees, multi-chain bridges and a built-in DEX, while disclosing temporary security restrictions ahead of a public mainnet launch in the coming months.
